item.title: Nashville Public Radio Names Jason Moon Wilkins As New Music Station Program Director
item.description: Nashville Public Radio has named Jason Moon Wilkins as the Program Director of its new music discovery radio station which launches later this fall on 91.1 FM. item.title: Nashville Public Radio Announces 91.ONE, WNXP’s Music Director And Production Coordinator
item.description: Nashville Public Radio announces Jewly Hight as 91.ONE, WNXP’s Music Director, and Marquis Munson as WNXP’s Production Coordinator. Hight and Munson complete the listener-supported station’s weekday on-air staff.
